title: Inside the Atrium
description: Morning showers mist more than 4,500 different plant species at the Eden Project in Cornwall, England. The environmental and educational center was built in 2001 and consists of two biomes. The larger one is the Rainforest Biome, which houses the biggest indoor rainforest in the world.
translated_description: 晨间的水雾喷洒滋养着英国康沃尔郡伊甸园项目中超过4500种不同的植物。这座环境教育中心建于2001年，由两个生态气候区组成。其中较大的热带雨林生态区拥有全球最大的室内雨林。
